source: IPCC SR15 SPM (coral reefs); IPCC AR6 (ice sheets, sea level by 2100); Climate Action Tracker Nov 2025 (benchmark futures)
note: Strip runs 1.0-4.5C above 1850-1900. Sea level likely ranges are vs 1995-2014. Ice-sheet zone: sustained warming between 2C and 3C commits Greenland and West Antarctica to near-complete, irreversible loss over millennia (9-11 m of sea level).

consequences.label: Greenland & West Antarctica pass the point of no return
consequences.detail: sustained warming in this zone: near-complete, irreversible loss over millennia, 9–11 m of sea level (IPCC AR6)
